name: tinker-video-downloader
description: Video Downloader Plugin for TINKER (based on yt-dlp)

zh-CN.name: 视频下载
zh-CN.description: 使用 yt-dlp 下载视频（需自行安装 yt-dlp）

query.description: Parse a video URL with yt-dlp and return title, formats, and metadata. Call this before download. Updates the plugin UI.

url.description: Video URL supported by yt-dlp, e.g. https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=...

download.description: Start downloading the video previously queried via query. Returns immediately with taskId; use get_progress to poll status. Optionally set formatId and downloadPath.

formatId.description: formatId from query.formats. Defaults to the currently selected format.

downloadPath.description: Absolute directory for this download. Falls back to the path set in the plugin UI when omitted.

get_progress.description: Get download progress. Pass taskId for one task, or omit it to list all tasks.

taskId.description: Task id returned by download. Omit to list all tasks.
